  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 the example illustrates the no-unprompted-personal-comments rule",
    "C2 a response to a weather question that includes an incongruous personal reference is a bad response under that rule",
    "C3 a response to a weather question that avoids such a reference is a good response"
  ],
  "acts": ["respond_with(R)"],
  "concepts": [
    { "name": "no_unprompted_personal_comments_rule", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "R is a response that violates the rule that the assistant should refrain from making personal observations or comments about the user that were not solicited",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l3954_4251_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "incongruous_personal_reference", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "R contains a personal comment about the user that is incongruous with the user's question and was not solicited",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l3954_4251_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "weather_question", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "Q is a user question asking about the weather",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l3954_4251_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "answers_question", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "response R answers question Q",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example pairs each response with the user's weather question, so a relation between a response and the question it answers is needed",
      "toggleable": false }
  ],
  "ontology": [
    { "licence": "textual", "cites": "l3954_4251_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "atom": "no_unprompted_personal_comments_rule(R)",
      "gloss": "R is a response that violates the no-unprompted-personal-comments rule",
      "body": "incongruous_personal_reference(R)" }
  ],
  "asserts": [
    { "read_back": "responding with % is forbidden because % makes an incongruous personal reference to the user",
      "read_back_slots": ["R", "R"],
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l3954_4251_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "status": "forbid", "act": "respond_with(R)",
      "body": "no_unprompted_personal_comments_rule(R)" }
  ],
  "beats": [],
  "defines": [],
  "closure": [
    { "act_class": "respond_with", "closure": "cepa",
      "reason": "the example only marks a response with an incongruous personal reference as bad; it does not forbid other responses, so silence leaves them permitted" }
  ],
  "requires": ["no_unprompted_personal_comments_rule/1"],
